name: Frost warriors
description: Ice warriors conjured from the swirling snow by Hylda to drive off Kellan and Ruby.

description_citations.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
description_citations.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Hylda's voice warns them to turn back and summons frost warriors, one pinning Kellan's cloak and another seizing Ruby.
timeline.quote: Another warrior's formed, and this one's got her in its clutches.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan pleads to his father and his hilts become a blade of light that cuts down the warriors' arms; he frees Ruby.
timeline.quote: his newfound sword cuts straight through the frost warrior's arm.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.
